definitions.alignment: dot(rotated body +X, normalized component-center minus detonation-position); current single component is centered at origin

quaternion_representation.note: The archive uses a qw>=0 hemisphere convention; the representation seam remains near 180-degree rotations.

cone_axis_los_cosine.definition: dot(rotated body +X fragment-cone axis, detonation-to-component line of sight)

naive_tree_on_aggregate_leaf_means.note: Compares mean(per-replicate fully-dependent OR) with max(aggregate combined.failed, aggregate blast.degraded).
